description: Documentation of compiled measurement rules; not a downloaded board-profile file. See src/testboard/testing/MeasurementPolicy.cpp.

policies.binding: Exact built-in ID, hardware/PCB revision, input numbers/nets and connector IDs/types/contact numbers/nets/expected masks. Unknown or changed electrical profiles have no exceptions.
policies.acceptance: Forward conduction plus reverse isolation with verified direct positive paths at both source contacts. Completed connectors only; any reverse conduction overrides positive evidence.
